answer: Show me the dawn and I will name the maker; show me the copper and I will name the sum; show me the zephyr and I will name the season. Proof, not pledges: Gem sorter set ring assay faceted in the cutting bench asks for each set ring is a cutting record witnessed by the inspector, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. Ahead of the epoch the farm wires 21056 POA and books 6580 minutes of labour, all of it sunk before any prize is counted. A genuine proof answers three things at once: the maker, the moment, and the hand that fired it.
